other_conditions: Any individual resident of India is eligible
A guardian may apply on behalf of a minor (minimum age 10 years) or a person of unsound mind
Single holder accounts can be opened by an adult for self, or on behalf of a minor or a person of unsound mind, or by a minor aged 10 years or more
Joint A‑Type accounts may be opened jointly by up to three adults, payable to all holders jointly or to the survivor(s)
Joint B‑Type accounts may be opened jointly by up to three adults, payable to any holder or to the survivor(s)
An individual may open any number of accounts
No maximum limit on deposit amount
benefits_summary: Offers a 7.7% interest rate compounded annually, payable at maturity after a 5‑year term, with no maximum deposit limit.
documents_required: passbook or deposit receipt/statement of account in original
